name: IP to ASN (Team Cymru - DoH Based)
summary: IP → ASN and IP → Country enrichment for IP Address nodes from Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN mapping.
description:
Routing context for IP Address nodes: the autonomous system that announces each address, and the country recorded for its announcing prefix, from Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN mapping. Each lookup is a DNS TXT query sent over DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH), so the pack needs no server, no API key and no data download.

## Plugins

### IP → ASN

- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes, IPv4 and IPv6.
- **Adds:** an Autonomous System node (`autonomous_system_number`, `autonomous_system_name`, `country_code`, `registry`) linked `announced by`, and sets the IP's `asn` field (for example `15169`).
- **Notes:** the AS name is a second query, made once per AS in a run, and each AS gets one node per run however many of the selected addresses it announces. When Cymru lists more than one origin AS for a prefix, the first is used.

### IP → Country

- **Runs on:** selected IP Address nodes, IPv4 and IPv6.
- **Adds:** sets the IP's `country_code` to the country Cymru records for its announcing prefix. Creates no nodes or edges.

## How the lookup works

| Lookup | DNS name queried (TXT) | Answer fields |
|---|---|---|
| IPv4 `a.b.c.d` | `d.c.b.a.origin.asn.cymru.com` | ASN, prefix, country, registry, date |
| IPv6 | nibble-reversed address under `origin6.asn.cymru.com` | the same |
| AS name | `AS<n>.asn.cymru.com` | ASN, country, registry, date, AS name |

The query goes to Cloudflare's DoH resolver (`https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query`), and to Google's (`https://dns.google/resolve`) when Cloudflare fails.

## Requirements

- No API key, account or token.
- Runs in the web app; the desktop app is not needed, because both resolvers answer cross-origin requests.
- Uses `infrastructure.ip_address` and `infrastructure.autonomous_system` from the Infrastructure type pack.

## What it contacts

- **cloudflare-dns.com**, and **dns.google** when Cloudflare fails, receive each query name. The name encodes the IP address being looked up (reversed), or the AS number for a name lookup.
- **Team Cymru's DNS servers** receive the query from the resolver, not from the analyst. Cloudflare's resolver caches the answers for about four hours, matching Cymru's update cycle, so repeated lookups do not all reach Cymru.
- The addresses under investigation are never contacted: every lookup is passive.

## Data and licences

The data is Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN mapping service, https://www.team-cymru.com/ip-asn-mapping. Team Cymru recommends its DNS interface for recurring lookups, and that is the interface this pack uses. This repository does not restate the service's terms.

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-iptoasn-cymru-doh (MIT). `dist/pack.mjs` is built from `src/` with a pinned esbuild (`node build.mjs`), so the published bundle can be checked against the source.

plugins.name: IP → ASN
plugins.description: Resolves the autonomous system announcing each selected IP Address (Team Cymru). Creates an Autonomous System node (number, name, country, registry) linked "announced by" and sets the IP's asn (e.g. 15169).

network.purpose: Look up the AS announcing each selected IP in Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN data.
Same lookup, used when cloudflare-dns.com fails.

plugins.name: IP → Country
plugins.description: Sets each selected IP Address's country_code from Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN data for its announcing prefix. Creates no nodes.

network.purpose: Look up the country of each selected IP's announcing prefix in Team Cymru's IP-to-ASN data.
Same lookup, used when cloudflare-dns.com fails.
